summary: Quote on NSE cash across a dropped socket: the feed reconnects with the same query and subscribes again; the first frame after it reports 0 for every price and, with nothing held on the new connection, publishes nothing; the next priced frame carries only what the new connection sent.

notes: The first frame is the web test's FEED with OpenRate 445.5; the frames after the reconnect are worked here: no trade yet on the new connection (every price 0, the quantities as sent), then a trade at 440.30 with the other prices still 0.

deviations.reason: The web keeps its snapshot across a reconnect (fivepaisa_adapter.py _on_open and _on_close leave last_snapshot), so a frame 5paisa sends after it with a price of 0 goes out with the pre-outage price as current; the desktop starts each connection afresh and leaves a price it does not have out (lead decision: restarting the merge after a reconnect is a desktop improvement).
